evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/services/workflow_executor.rs:659 — the `Matches` comparison operator calls `regex::Regex::new(pattern)` on every single workflow condition evaluation. `pattern` is `compare_value.as_str()`, i.e. an org-authored stored workflow condition. grep of the file finds exactly one `Regex::new` and no `Lazy`/`OnceCell`/cache, so the pattern is recompiled from scratch for every event that reaches the condition.

Cost/DoS amplification on a hot automation path: a workflow bound to a high-frequency event type (e.g. a per-notification or per-fault trigger) recompiles its regex on each matching event. A workflow author can also store an expensive-to-compile pattern (the crate's default 10MB compiled-size ceiling is large) that is paid on every evaluation rather than once. Fix: compile once and cache (e.g. an LRU/`OnceCell` keyed by pattern) and/or set an explicit `RegexBuilder::size_limit`.

Confidence medium: static read confirms the recompile-per-eval and absence of any cache; the reachability (event -> evaluate_condition -> Matches) is via the stored-condition path and not runtime-confirmed for frequency.

backend/servers/api-server/src/services/workflow_executor.rs:640-652 — `ComparisonOperator::In` returns `Ok(false)` when `compare_value.as_array()` is `None` (fails closed), but `ComparisonOperator::NotIn` returns `Ok(true)` in the same malformed case (fails open).

Effect: a workflow condition authored as `NotIn` whose value is mis-typed (object/string/number instead of a JSON array) silently matches every event and fires the workflow's downstream actions, with no error surfaced to the author (contrast `Matches`, which returns a `ConditionError` on a non-string pattern). Recommend returning a `WorkflowError::ConditionError` for a non-array `In`/`NotIn` value so a malformed condition is rejected rather than firing unintentionally.
Confidence medium: asymmetry is clear from the source; whether a mis-typed `NotIn` config can actually be persisted depends on upstream config validation not traced in this static pass.
